newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DUTCH INTERNOC SEEKS LISTING ON EURO.NM.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH INTERNOC SEEKS LISTING ON EURO.NM.

text.p: Internoc, specialised in radio-controlled data-processing networks for small- and medium-sized companies, wants to list on the Brussels arm of the Euro.NM small caps market, lead-manager Smeets Verbaet said.

Shares are due to be listed before the end of the year, Jean-Louis Amez of the Corporate Finance Department of Smeets Verbaet told Reuters. In the 18 next months Internoc would seek a listing on Nasdaq.

Internoc, set up in the Netherlands in July 1996, built its first Network Operating Center (NOC) for 100,000 work stations in the Nederlands in March. It plans to build NOCs in France, Germany, and Great Britain and in the U.S. together with an American partner.
Internoc expects a loss of 8.3 million Dutch guilders in its first year, nine million guilders in profits in 1998 and a 45 million guilder profit in 1999.

Internoc expects the number of shares issued to rise from 12.7 million to 16.5 million at the end of the year with part of the 3.8 additional shares to be bought by a silent U.S. partner and the rest to be introduced on the Euro.NM.
